description: This file contains the implementation of the Session database backend class for OpenCart, providing methods to read, write, destroy, and garbage-collect session data stored in a database.
published:
Opencart
ameSpace or	he
amespace ut
ot\explicitly inal

classes.name: DB
classes.description: Provides database-backed session management, including reading, writing, destroying, and garbage collection of session data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the session database handler with registry dependencies.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Retrieves session data from the database based on session ID.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Stores or updates session data in the database with an expiration time.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Deletes session data associated with a given session ID.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection to delete expired sessions based on probability settings.
